messages:
Priya K: Heads-up — we need a clear, low-friction SEV path for partners (marketplace vendors, SI integrators, and hardware OEMs). Current handoffs are messy when incidents cross org boundaries.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Biggest pain is channel fragmentation — partner sends to vendor support, then we get a DM. We should standardize a single shared channel + war room flow.
Jordan M: +1. Proposal: create a temporary shared channel for each joint incident, name it `#partner-war-<partner>-<short-id>`, and follow a checklist.
Sophie L: Love that. Can we automate channel creation and include an onboarding post with roles? PartnerOps Bot can do that.
PartnerOps Bot: I can auto-provision channels and post the runbook. Need a template payload. Example:```json
{
  "channel": "#partner-war-acme-452",
  "owner": "oncall_team",
  "partner_liaison": "acme_oncall@example.com",
  "service_owner": "redwood-inference-team"
}
```
Mike R: Here's a short checklist we should auto-post in the new channel: 1) Stakeholder list + preferred contacts 2) Escalation ladder (SEV1/SEV2 owners) 3) Bridge link + backup phone 4) Data sensitivity note + SSO access 5) Agreed postmortem owner.
Priya K: Can we also add a routing rule: if the incident affects marketplace/commerce flows, page marketplace-oncall first; if it's infra/GPU hardware, page hw-integrations; otherwise page platform-oncall. That keeps teams triaged.
Alex Chen: Sounds good. For shared channels we need explicit partner consent and an NDA note. Add step: "Confirm data sharing consent" before channel is opened.
Jordan M: Suggest we keep a soft timeout: after 72h of no activity, PartnerOps Bot posts a decomm message and archives the channel unless someone objects.
Sophie L: I'll draft the short runbook and a sample onboarding post. Link to where we'll put the long form: https://redwood.internal/partner-sev-runbook (private).
Mike R: Quick sample onboarding post (to be auto-posted):
"Welcome to #partner-war-acme-452 — Roles: @Priya K (Partner PM), @Mike R (Redwood Platform), @Acme Ops (Partner). Bridge: <zoom link>. Escalation: SEV1 -> platform-oncall -> vp-ops. Data note: PII may be involved, use secure channel only"
Priya K: Great. Action items: Sophie to draft runbook, Alex to add channel automation hooks, Jordan to update oncall routing rules, Mike to finalize checklist. I'll sync with Legal about consent language.
Alex Chen: I'll open a quick PR for the provisioning lambda, will ping in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
PartnerOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: runbook draft due in 48h.
Sophie L: Thanks — starting the draft now.
Mike R: I'll prepare the escalation matrix spreadsheet and share here when done.
Priya K: Thanks team. If anyone has partner-specific constraints (SI licensing, hardware telemetry limits), flag them here before I talk to Legal.
